🦠 HMPV Virus: Precautionary Measures

Wash hands for at least 20 secs to control spread 🧼

Cover mouth & nose while coughing/sneezing 🤧

Wear a mask, avoid contact with the sick 😷

Avoid touching eyes, nose, mouth with unwashed hands ✋
